technical.summary: Early oversold bounce signals (stoch/RSI rising) lack confirmation from price structure, moving averages, and momentum; weak trend strength and below-cloud ichimoku suggest downtrend continuation risk.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 69 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no senior conviction; news data unavailable limits confirmation.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (344.64), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational IT sector; earnings in 69 days provides some buffer but overall environment is highly unfavourable for risk assets.

debate.key_bull_argument: Stochastic RSI cross-up and supertrend bullish signals in extreme fear environment (VIX crisis) offer contrarian oversold bounce opportunity near support at 248.58.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price below all major moving averages, weak trend strength (ADX 13.16), ichimoku below cloud, zero fundamental/smart money support, and severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis, flat yield curve, rising DXY) indicate downtrend continuation risk outweighs technical bounce signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Stochastic RSI cross-up and supertrend bullish offer technical bounce signals in extreme fear environment; however, price remains below all major moving averages with weak trend strength (ADX 13.16) and zero fundamental or smart money support.
decision.primary_risk: Severe macro headwinds (VIX crisis 344.64, flat yield curve, rising DXY) combined with ichimoku below cloud and downtrend structure suggest bounce is likely corrective within larger downtrend; earnings in 69 days add material uncertainty.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical agents show early bounce signals but fundamental, risk, and debate agents strongly favor bear case; macro environment overrides technical setup.
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 2 other IT holdings in 29-position portfolio creates sector concentration risk; skip entry to avoid compounding exposure in unfavourable macro environment.
